description: This PHP source file defines a class HomeViewTour that extends SugarView, responsible for rendering a tour view in the SuiteCRM application. It assigns language strings and configuration data to the view and conditionally displays a calendar URL based on upgrade history.

classes.name: HomeViewTour
classes.description: A view class for displaying a tour page in the SuiteCRM home module, extending SugarView and handling setup of language strings, global variables, and upgrade status checks.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the tour view template, assigns language strings, global variables, and a conditional URL for the calendar based on upgrade history.
